serviceDetails.title: What is a Megaflo unvented cylinder?
paras: A Megaflo works off the mains, so you get powerful hot water with no cold tank in the loft. Great for homes with more than one bathroom.

serviceDetails.title: Is a Megaflo fitted safely?
paras: We size the cylinder to your home, fit the safety parts, and test the flow. You get steady, strong hot water you can count on.

faqs.q: Do I have space for a Megaflo?
faqs.a: Most homes do. We check the space and advise on the right size.
Yes. We fit all the safety parts and test the system in full.

faqs.q: How much hot water does a Megaflo hold?
faqs.a: Sizes vary. We help you pick one to match your home.
